did.unittitle: Ford Foundation records, Special Collections, Government Correspondence

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: This material was transferred to RAC in 2019 and 2020 by the Ford Foundation and ingested by RAC as Accessions 2019:181 and 2020:018.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Arranged as received from the Ford Foundation.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The collection contains copies of letters sent to government officials from Ford Foundation presidents and program officers. The collection also holds correspondence from government officials regarding Ford Foundation grants to governmental and non-governmental entities as well as Ford Foundation programs generally.
